data.name: Ikhlaq
data.gender_notes: Ikhlaq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A reward or gift from God, symbolizing knowledge, wisdom, and creativity. The name Ikhlaq carries the meaning “Gift, Reward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Ikhlaq usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A spiritual reward or gift from God, representing knowledge, wisdom, and the creative expression of one's faith.
data.etymology: Ikhlaq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ikhlaq total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: إخلاق
in_arabic.meaning: إخلاق تعني الأخلاق الحميدة والصفات الحسنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: إخلاق هو اسم مشتق من الأخلاق، وهي الصفات الحميدة التي يتصف بها الإنسان، مثل الصدق، والكرم، والرحمة. وردت كلمة الأخلاق في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وَأَحسَنُ أُخُلُقًا مِنهُ مَن يَدعو إِلَی اللَّهِ وَيَعمَلُ صَالِحًا وَيَقُولُ إِنَّني مِنَ المُسْلِمِينَ' (سورة فصّلت: 33). يعتبر إخلاق من الأسماء التي تعبر عن القيم الإسلامية والصفات الحميدة.

in_urdu.name: اخلاق
in_urdu.meaning: اخلاق کا مطلب ہے اچھے اخلاق اور خوبیاں
in_urdu.long_meaning: اخلاق ایک ایسا نام ہے جو اچھے اخلاق اور خوبیاں سے جڑا ہوا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے وہ خوبیاں جو انسان کو بہتر بناتی ہیں، جیسے کہ صدق، کرم، اور مہربانی۔ قرآن کریم میں اخلاق کی اہمیت پر بار بار تاکید کی گئی ہے، جیسے کہ ارشاد ربانی ہے: 'اور سب سے اچھے اخلاق والے وہ ہیں جو اللہ کی طرف دعوت دیتے ہیں اور نیک کام کرتے ہیں' (سورة فصّلت: 33)۔

in_hindi.name: इख़्लाक़
in_hindi.meaning: इख़्लाक़ का अर्थ है अच्छे आचरण और अच्छे गुण
in_hindi.long_meaning: इख़्लाक़ एक ऐसा नाम है जो अच्छे आचरण और गुणों से संबंधित है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है वे गुण जो इंसान को बेहतर बनाते हैं, जैसे कि सच्चाई, उदारता, और दया। कुरआन में अच्छे आचरण के महत्व पर जोर दिया गया है, जैसे कि कहा गया है: 'और सबसे अच्छे आचरण वाले वे हैं जो अल्लाह की ओर دعوت देते हैं और अच्छे काम करते हैं' (सूरा फुस्सilat: 33)।

in_pashto.name: اخلاق
in_pashto.meaning: اخلاق د ښو اخلاقو او ځانګړتیاوو معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اخلاق داسې نوم دی چې د ښو اخلاقو او ځانګړتیاوو سره تړاو لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د هغه ځانګړتیاوو معنی دی چې انسان ته ښه والی ورکوي، لکه صدق، کرم، او مهربانۍ. په قرآن کریم کې د اخلاقو اهمیت ته ډیری وار تاکید شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې فرمايي: 'او تر ټولو ښو اخلاقو لرونکي هغه کسان دي چې الله ته دعوت ورکوي او نیک کارونه کوي' (سورت فصّلت: 33).

in_english.name: Ikhlaq
in_english.meaning: Ikhlaq means good morals, ethics, and virtues
in_english.long_meaning: Ikhlaq is a name that signifies good morals, ethics, and virtues. Derived from Arabic, it encompasses qualities like honesty, generosity, and compassion. The Quran emphasizes the importance of good character, stating, 'And the best of character are those who call upon Allah and do righteous deeds' (Surah Fussilat: 33). In Islamic tradition, Ikhlaq is considered a desirable trait, reflecting a person's inner goodness and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ikhlaq holds immense cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is derived from the Arabic root "Khalaqa," which means to create. In the context of the name, it implies the act of creating something beautiful and valuable through hard work, effort, and God's grace. The name Ikhlaq is often given to instill a sense of creativity, originality, and innovation in individuals. It is believed to inspire individuals to strive for excellence in their chosen fields and to leave a positive impact on society. Moreover, the name is also associated with the concept of "hadar," which means elegance, refinement, and good manners.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Ikhlaq holds immense significance in Islamic thought. It is a reminder of the divine nature of creation and the human potential to create things that reflect the beauty and wisdom of God. The name Ikhlaq symbolizes the belief that knowledge, wisdom, and creativity are gifts from God, bestowed upon individuals to help them fulfill their purpose in life. Additionally, the name is also a reminder of the importance of spiritual growth and the need to seek God's guidance in all aspects of life. By embodying the name Ikhlaq, individuals are encouraged to strive for excellence, creativity, and originality while remaining deeply connected to God and seeking His pleasure.
